set.body:
Problem: group.first-level-bridge.v1 and group.first-level-to-group-known-effect.v1 reference suites that moved from modules/group to modules/fit-estimates.
Files: docs/scenarios/manifest.json; tools/scenarios/validate_manifest.py only if a targeted fixture/test is needed.
Steps: update each suite_path to the actual fit-estimates location; update module and acceptance command fields together to fitEstimatesJVM and fitEstimatesJS. Preserve scenario IDs, oracle declarations, allowed statuses and clean-Pass policy. Inspect the full manifest for any other paths changed by the same module split; do not delete scenarios to make validation pass.
Acceptance: both named suites execute via fitEstimatesJVM/testOnly and fitEstimatesJS/testOnly; both registrations resolve to existing source files and the correct modules. Run python3 -S tools/scenarios/validate_manifest.py. If its only failure is the separately tracked mixed-TR lock contract, record that explicitly until P4.4c lands. Do not broaden accepted caveats or regenerate numerical truth.
set.title: P4.4b: move first-level bridge scenario registrations to fit-estimates
